name: Facility Operations
description: Starter pack for facility and building operations: daily walkthroughs, preventive maintenance cycles, safety checks and compliance renewals.

definitions.title: Daily building walkthrough
definitions.note: Walk the site, check doors, lighting, water leaks and general condition.
steps: Walk the exterior and check doors and locks
Check common areas for leaks, smells or damage
Log anything unusual in the chat for the day

definitions.title: Open and close checklist
definitions.note: Opening and closing duties for the building.
steps: Open: unlock, switch lights, check heating
Close: walk through, switch off, lock up

definitions.title: Weekly equipment check
definitions.note: Test pumps, generators and water heaters briefly and note any noise or faults.

definitions.title: Monthly fire extinguisher inspection
definitions.note: Check pressure gauges, seals, pin and accessibility of every extinguisher.
steps: Check gauge is in the green zone
Check safety pin and tamper seal
Confirm clear access and signed inspection tag

definitions.title: Monthly HVAC filter check
definitions.note: Inspect and replace air filters as needed.

definitions.title: Monthly water temperature check
definitions.note: Record hot water temperature at outlets to prevent legionella risk.

definitions.title: Quarterly fire alarm test
definitions.note: Full alarm test with the fire panel log and any contractor.

definitions.title: Quarterly generator test
definitions.note: Run the backup generator under load for 30 minutes and record the result.

definitions.title: Emergency lighting test
definitions.note: Simulate a power cut and check that all emergency lights and exit signs work.

definitions.title: Pest control visit
definitions.note: Vendor visit - verify service report and file it.

definitions.title: Annual insurance review
definitions.note: Review building and liability insurance coverage and renewals before year end.

definitions.title: Annual fire safety certificate renewal
definitions.note: Book the annual fire inspection and file the certificate.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc repair request
definitions.note: One-off repair or vendor call - set the due date when creating it.
